import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long P = 1000000007;

    static class FiniteField {
        private long x;

        public FiniteField(long x) {
            if (x > P || x < 0) {
                System.err.println("Invalid FiniteField!");
                System.exit(1);
            }
            this.x = x;
        }

        public FiniteField() {
            this.x = 0;
        }

        public long Value() {
            return x;
        }

        public FiniteField plus(FiniteField o) {
            return new FiniteField((x + o.x) % P);
        }

        public FiniteField minus(FiniteField o) {
            return new FiniteField((x + P - o.x) % P);
        }

        public FiniteField times(FiniteField o) {
            return new FiniteField((x * o.x) % P);
        }

        public FiniteField divide(FiniteField o) {
            return new FiniteField((x * modInverse(o.x, P)) % P);
        }

        private long modInverse(long a, long m) {
            // Fermat's little theorem for modular inverse
            return pow(a, m - 2, m);
        }

        private long pow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
            long result = 1;
            long cur = base % mod;
            while (exp > 0) {
                if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                    result = (result * cur) % mod;
                }
                cur = (cur * cur) % mod;
                exp >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static <T> List<List<T>> make2DVector(int d1, int d2, T default_value) {
        List<List<T>> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < d1; i++) {
            List<T> row = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(d2, default_value));
            result.add(row);
        }
        return result;
    }

    static <T> List<List<List<T>>> make3DVector(int d1, int d2, int d3, T default_value) {
        List<List<List<T>>> result = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < d1; i++) {
            result.add(make2DVector(d2, d3, default_value));
        }
        return result;
    }

    static <T> List<List<T>> matrixMultiply(List<List<T>> a1, List<List<T>> a2, java.util.function.BiFunction<T, T, T> add, java.util.function.BiFunction<T, T, T> mul, T zero) {
        int n = a1.size();
        int m = a1.get(0).size();
        int l = a2.get(0).size();
        if (a2.size() != m) {
            System.err.println("Matrix dimensions don't match for multiplication!");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        List<List<T>> result = make2DVector(n, l, zero);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < l; j++) {
                T sum = zero;
                for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                    T prod = mul.apply(a1.get(i).get(k), a2.get(k).get(j));
                    sum = add.apply(sum, prod);
                }
                result.get(i).set(j, sum);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    static <T> List<T> matrixVectorMultiply(List<List<T>> matrix, List<T> v, java.util.function.BiFunction<T, T, T> add, java.util.function.BiFunction<T, T, T> mul, T zero) {
        int n = matrix.size();
        int m = matrix.get(0).size();
        if (v.size() != m) {
            System.err.println("Matrix and vector dimensions don't match for multiplication!");
            System.exit(1);
        }
        List<T> result = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(n, zero));
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            T sum = zero;
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                T prod = mul.apply(matrix.get(i).get(j), v.get(j));
                sum = add.apply(sum, prod);
            }
            result.set(i, sum);
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        // Initialize shifts
        List<List<List<FiniteField>>> shifts = make3DVector(d, d + 1, d + 1, new FiniteField(0));
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < d; i++) {
                shifts.get(k).get(i).set((i + k) % d, new FiniteField(1));
            }
            shifts.get(k).get(d).set(d, new FiniteField(1));
        }

        // Initialize units
        List<List<List<FiniteField>>> units = make3DVector(d, d + 1, d + 1, new FiniteField(0));
        for (int k = 0; k < d; k++) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                units.get(k).get(i).set(i, new FiniteField(1));
            }
            for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
                units.get(k).get(k).set(i, new FiniteField(1));
            }
        }

        // Initialize identity
        List<List<FiniteField>> identity = make2DVector(d + 1, d + 1, new FiniteField(0));
        for (int i = 0; i <= d; i++) {
            identity.get(i).set(i, new FiniteField(1));
        }

        Map<Long, List<List<FiniteField>>> cache = new HashMap<>();

        // Recursive function to find matrix
        class MatrixFinder {
            public List<List<FiniteField>> findMatrix(long p) {
                if (cache.containsKey(p)) {
                    return cache.get(p);
                }
                List<List<FiniteField>> result;
                if (p <= d) {
                    result = deepCopyMatrix(identity);
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        result = matrixMultiply(units.get(k), result, FiniteField::plus, FiniteField::times, new FiniteField(0));
                    }
                    cache.put(p, result);
                    return result;
                }
                long child_p = d;
                while ((p + child_p - 1) / child_p > d) {
                    child_p *= d;
                }
                List<List<FiniteField>> child = findMatrix(child_p);
                result = deepCopyMatrix(child);
                long remaining_p = p - child_p;
                for (int k = 1; k < d; k++) {
                    if (remaining_p >= child_p) {
                        result = matrixMultiply(shifts.get(d - k), result, FiniteField::plus, FiniteField::times, new FiniteField(0));
                        result = matrixMultiply(result, shifts.get(k), FiniteField::plus, FiniteField::times, new FiniteField(0));
                        remaining_p -= child_p;
                    } else if (remaining_p > 0) {
                        List<List<FiniteField>> temp = findMatrix(remaining_p);
                        result = matrixMultiply(shifts.get(d - k), temp, FiniteField::plus, FiniteField::times, new FiniteField(0));
                        result = matrixMultiply(result, shifts.get(k), FiniteField::plus, FiniteField::times, new FiniteField(0));
                        remaining_p = 0;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                cache.put(p, result);
                return result;
            }
        }

        List<List<FiniteField>> matrix;
        {
            MatrixFinder finder = new MatrixFinder();
            matrix = finder.findMatrix(n);
        }

        // Base vector
        List<FiniteField> base_vector = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(d + 1, new FiniteField(0)));
        base_vector.set(d, new FiniteField(1));

        List<FiniteField> final_vector = matrixVectorMultiply(matrix, base_vector, FiniteField::plus, FiniteField::times, new FiniteField(0));

        FiniteField ans = new FiniteField(0);
        for (FiniteField x : final_vector) {
            ans = ans.plus(x);
        }
        System.out.println(ans.Value());
    }

    private static List<List<FiniteField>> deepCopyMatrix(List<List<FiniteField>> matrix) {
        List<List<FiniteField>> copy = new ArrayList<>();
        for (List<FiniteField> row : matrix) {
            copy.add(new ArrayList<>(row));
        }
        return copy;
    }
}
